about.description: Entropy is a HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetual venue on Hyperliquid operating the 'io' dex namespace, launched 2026-08-18 with equity, index and pre-IPO perpetual markets. Deployer 0x320c8988e3d1b5198f335802d7bfd2728a8fcac6; oracle updater 0x94757f8dcb4bf73b850195660e959d1105cfedd5. Markets cash-settle in USDC. Pre-IPO markets quote in market-cap units rather than per-share prices and carry a two-year no-IPO resolution that settles to the 30-day trailing TWAP of the mark.
about.registryInfo: Publicly announced a $14M raise led by Ribbit Capital plus a $40M HYPE stake (issuer claim, not independently verified as of 2026-08-25). Operates the 'io' HIP-3 namespace on Hyperliquid.

fees.revenueNotes: HIP-3 builder-deployer on Hyperliquid. Fees are 2x the standard HL perp schedule (3.0 bps maker / 9.0 bps taker), protocol fee split evenly with Hyperliquid; deployerFeeScale 1.0. Both live markets have growth mode enabled (2026-08-19), scaling all fees, rebates and volume contribution by 0.1, so the effective schedule is 0.30 bps maker / 0.90 bps taker. Funding is peer-to-peer with no exchange cut, so there is no funding skim.
